versions.subject: feat: more updates
versions.detection:
selection_ntds:
    TargetFilename|endswith: '\ntds.dit'
selection_process_img:
    Image|endswith:
        # Add more suspicious processes as you see fit
        - '\cmd.exe'
        - '\cscript.exe'
        - '\mshta.exe'
        - '\powershell.exe'
        - '\pwsh.exe'
        - '\regsvr32.exe'
        - '\rundll32.exe'
        - '\wscript.exe'
        - '\wsl.exe'
        - '\wt.exe'
selection_process_paths:
    Image|contains:
        - '\AppData\'
        - '\Temp\'
        - '\Public\'
        - '\PerfLogs\'
condition: selection_ntds and 1 of selection_process_*
versions.spl: TargetFilename="*\\ntds.dit" Image IN ("*\\cmd.exe", "*\\cscript.exe", "*\\mshta.exe", "*\\powershell.exe", "*\\pwsh.exe", "*\\regsvr32.exe", "*\\rundll32.exe", "*\\wscript.exe", "*\\wsl.exe", "*\\wt.exe") OR Image IN ("*\\AppData\\*", "*\\Temp\\*", "*\\Public\\*", "*\\PerfLogs\\*")
